## Introduction

ISO 30500:2022 outlines the standard for Information Management Systems (IMS) and related standards. This standard is highly relevant for sports, military, and the military industrial clean-up sectors, among others. 

This document defines IMS, models its processes and their relationship with sustainable development, and provides a clear focus on information to realize specific goals (ISO 30500:2022).

## Active IMS Elements

The IMS document consists of elements, interactions, and processes organized according to a guideline:

- **Information generation and storage**
  - These are foundational elements. For instance, personal information may be stored in hardware-readable form to what is to be accessed, and it may also be stored in what is not readable. Other information is unlikely to be stored since a given person’s awareness is not safe. Namely, IMS consists of stored data and information for operational support and supply for the sports, military, and military industrial clean-up sectors, among others.
  
- **Intellectual Property (IP) Management**
  - Intellectual property is an informal term for creating awareness of patents, trademarks, and proprietary technology or methods. This creates legal monopolies in the field of IMS. The fact that we are in the continuous production phase for technological achievements points to the crucial role that IMS plays in today’s world.
  
- **Relationships**
  - Materials and supplies, information, intellectual property, and operational personnel are important parts of the IMS. The technical information also becomes an intelligent interface to other elements but it remains intangible. In order to achieve IMS, we need technological works, processes, systems, tools, people, robots, software, robots, materials, supplies, information, IP, materials, supplies, information, IP, materials, supply alternatives, and solutions.
  
- **Vehicle Life Cycle Management**
  - IMS is used to sort, manage, and control the life cycle of sports and support us in our activities. It includes creating, deleting, designing, reviewing, and controlling operational requirements. It also encompasses construction, operation, repair, and maintenance of sports and supporting us in our activities. In order to accomplish successful results, we are constantly facing new problems to be solved and IT solutions are provided at the base.

value.## Road vehicles — Comparison between ISO 26262-12 and other parts of the ISO 26262 series to support motorcycle adaptation

### 1 Scope

This document lists differences between ISO 26262-12:2018 and other parts of the ISO 26262 series, and supports the adaptation of the ISO 26262 series for motorcycles by clarifying the intention.

This document is based on ISO 26262-12:2018 and makes a comparison with the following documents:

— ISO 26262-2:2018,

— ISO 26262-3:2018,

— ISO 26262-4:2018.

### 2 Normative references

The following documents are referred to in the text in such a way that some or all of their content constitutes requirements of this document. For dated references, only the edition cited applies. For undated references, the latest edition of the referenced document (including any amendments) applies.

ISO 26262-1:2018, *Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 1: Vocabulary*

### 3 Terms and definitions

For the purposes of this document, the terms, definitions and abbreviated terms given in ISO 26262-1 apply.

ISO and IEC maintain terminology databases for use in standardization at the following addresses:

— ISO Online browsing platform: available at https://www.iso.org/obj

— IEC Electropedia: available at https://www.electropedia.org/

### 4 General

#### 4.1 Overview

The objective of this clause is to give an overview of the comparison in this document. This clause describes the contents of ISO 26262-12:2018 and the superseded clauses from ISO 26262-2:2018, ISO 26262-3:2018 and ISO 26262-4:2018. However, identical clauses (Clause 1 to Clause 4) in all parts are excluded from comparison. Additionally, annexes are also excluded from the comparison because of their informative nature.

123 differences are identified as the target of categorization by comparison. The overview for each clause is as follows.

— In Clause 5 regarding safety culture, 5 differences are categorized. These are mainly relevant to communication channels and changed because these are implemented to limited models of motorcycle.

Source: Reviewing the literature shows that the most common method used for collecting IREF data involves the use of tables and charts. Tables are used to present the collected information, while charts such as scatter plots, bar graphs, and pie charts are used to highlight the data trends and relationships. In addition, there are other tools that can be used to collect IREF data, such as electronic questionnaires and online surveys. Each of these tools has its advantages and disadvantages, and the choice of the most appropriate one depends on the specific needs and preferences of the researchers. Generally, electronic questionnaires are useful for collecting large amounts of data quickly and easily, while online surveys are more convenient for interviewing participants from all over the world. Ultimately, the success of the IREF process depends on the careful planning and execution of the data collection phase.

The use of quantitative data collection methods provides a strong foundation for the analysis and interpretation of the collected information. It allows researchers to generate accurate and reliable results that can be used to inform decision-making processes in various fields. By carefully evaluating the strengths and limitations of each data collection method, researchers can choose the most appropriate approach to suit their specific needs and objectives.

Footnote: Additionally, aside from using specific tools to collect large amounts of data from participants, one alternative to doing so is conducting interviews with human panelists (Kahneman, & Tversky, 2011; Fountain, et al., 2020).

The Strengths and Weaknesses of the Comparison and Categorization Methods

\begin{center}
\textbf{About us}

We bring together business, industry, government, consumers, innovators and others to shape their combined experience and expertise into standards-based solutions.

The knowledge embodied in our standards has been carefully assembled in a dependable format and refined through our open consultation process. Organizations of all sizes and across all sectors choose standards to help them achieve their goals.

\textit{Information on standards}

We can provide you with the knowledge that your organization needs to succeed. Find out more about British Standards by visiting our website at bisgroup.com/standards or contacting our Customer Service team or Knowledge Centre.

\textit{Buying standards}

You can buy and download PDF versions of BS publications, including British and adopted European and international standards, through our website at bisgroup.com/shop, where hard copies can also be purchased.

If you need international and foreign standards from other Standards Development Organizations, hard copies can be ordered from our Customer Service team.

\textit{Copyright in BS publications}

All the content in BS publications, including British Standards, is the property of and copyrighted by BS or some person or entity that owns copyright in the information used (such as the international standardization bodies) and has formally licensed such information to BS for commercial publication and use.

Save for the provisions below, you may not transfer, share or disseminate any portion of the standard to any other person. You may not adapt, distribute, commercially exploit or publicly display the standard or any portion thereof in any manner whatsoever without BS’s prior written consent.

\textit{Storing and using standards}

Standards purchased in soft copy format:

\begin{itemize}
\item A British Standard purchased in soft copy format is licensed to a sole named user for personal or internal company use only.
\item The standard may be stored on more than one device provided that it is accessible by the sole named user only and that only one copy is accessed at any one time.
\item A single paper copy may be printed for personal or internal company use only.
\end{itemize}

Standards purchased in hard copy format:

\begin{itemize}
\item A British Standard purchased in hard copy format is for personal or internal company use only.
\item It may not be further reproduced – in any format – to create an additional copy. This includes scanning of the document.
\end{itemize}

If you need more than one copy of the document, or if you wish to share the document on an internal network, you can save money by choosing a subscription product (see ‘Subscriptions’).

\textbf{Reproducing extracts}

For permission to reproduce content from BS publications contact the BS Copyright and Licensing team.

\textbf{Subscriptions}

Our range of subscription services are designed to make using standards easier for you. For further information on our subscription products go to bisgroup.com/subscriptions.

With \textit{British Standards Online (BSOL)} you’ll have instant access to over 55,000 British and adopted European and international standards from your desktop. It’s available 24/7 and is refreshed daily so you’ll always be up to date.

%You can keep in touch with standards developments and receive substantial discounts on the purchase price of standards, both in single copy and subscription format, by becoming a \textbf{BSI Subscribing Member}.

\textbf{PUIS} is an updating service exclusive to BSI Subscribing Members. You will automatically receive the latest hard copy of your standards when they’re revised or replaced.

To find out more about becoming a BSI Subscribing Member and the benefits of membership, please visit bisgroup.com/shop.

With a \textbf{Multi-User Network Licence (MUNL)} you are able to host standards publications on your intranet. Licences can cover as few or as many users as you wish. With updates supplied as soon as they’re available, you can be sure your documentation is current. For further information, email \texttt{cservices@bisgroup.com}.

\textbf{Revisions}

Our British Standards and other publications are updated by amendment or revision. We continually improve the quality of our products and services to benefit your business. If you find an inaccuracy or ambiguity within a British Standard or other BSI publication please inform the Knowledge Centre.
